name: Atomic-Affine-Bagged-QRF
primary_rule: For every Bayesian-bootstrap Exp(1) normalized draw, fit nonnegative coefficients with sum <= 2 and an unrestricted intercept to minimize weighted OOF absolute loss. Average all 128 coefficient vectors and intercepts. Same 32 cached mean/median training-only predictors as the existing method. No additional hyperparameter selection.
ablation_rule: bayesian_shift enforces coefficient sum=1 but retains unrestricted intercept; isolates intercept from scale calibration. Original Bayesian-simplex control kept for every matched seed.
centering: Subtract outer-training median response from targets and every OOF predictor; scale by 100 MPa for LP conditioning. Undo centering exactly at prediction.
refits: Reuse previously fully reproduced training-only OOFs and final components, train any newly active missing configuration at unchanged 900-tree settings.
scope: Public retrospective benchmark development after all bagged-simplex outcomes known. Affine/shift outcomes not computed or viewed at freeze. All declared seeds and policies will be reported, with seed417 reference retained regardless of repeats or ablation.
claim_scope: Numerical exact-official-fold comparison; not prospective independence or accepted leaderboard record. No physical qualification, no realized saving.
